pages.text: $(bold)Slotless upgrade: Blasphemy$() — Those who defile the gods are forsaken by them.$(br2)Grants the armor $(l)2$() extra defense slots, but increases damage taken by $(c)10%$() (applied after armor reduction; stacks multiplicatively per piece worn).$(br2)Installing costs no slots; cannot be washed off or extracted.
$(bold)Recipe$() (goety): Pure Unholy Blood ×1, Essence of Shadow ×2, Nether Brick Brazier ×2 — applied to Tinkers' armor.
